갈라디아서 4:1.content: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

갈라디아서 4:2.content: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

갈라디아서 4:3.content: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

갈라디아서 4:4.content: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

갈라디아서 4:5.content: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

갈라디아서 4:6.content: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

갈라디아서 4:7.content: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

갈라디아서 4:8.content: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

갈라디아서 4:9.content: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

갈라디아서 4:10.content: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

갈라디아서 4:11.content: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

갈라디아서 4:12.content: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

갈라디아서 4:13.content: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

갈라디아서 4:14.content: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

갈라디아서 4:15.content: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

갈라디아서 4:16.content: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

갈라디아서 4:17.content: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

갈라디아서 4:18.content: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

갈라디아서 4:19.content: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

갈라디아서 4:20.content: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

갈라디아서 4:21.content: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

갈라디아서 4:22.content: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

갈라디아서 4:23.content: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

갈라디아서 4:24.content: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

갈라디아서 4:25.content: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

갈라디아서 4:26.content: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

갈라디아서 4:27.content: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

갈라디아서 4:28.content: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

갈라디아서 4:29.content: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

갈라디아서 4:30.content: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

갈라디아서 4:31.content: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
